title: The Bug in the Pot
lines: A bug is on a bag.
"A bug!" said Gus. "Do not tap it."
Ted taps a pot on it.
Gus digs up a cap. It is on the pot.
A bud is up in a tub.
Gus and Ted tug the pot to the tub.
The bug is on the bud!
scoring_note: This passage says "do not", "it is". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" or "it's" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
